verdict.rationale: Solid's own README says it ships full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration, explicitly to reach interactivity as quickly as possible. That matches the story directly, but the evidence is only brief README feature claims. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how progressive hydration is configured or used (APIs, hydration boundaries), independent or hands-on corroboration of faster time-to-interactive.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hydrate my server-rendered app progressively so pages become interactive faster

citations.quote: Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.
Provides modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Context, Portals, Suspense, streaming SSR, progressive hydration, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering.
Isomorphic: render your components on the client and the server
